title: Phase 1 — trusted authorization + read-only operational status foundation for PAIR Chat (Independent Audit R3 closure)
description: R3 CORRECTION on BASE 5b5ab73 (audited HEAD fefb6b7; R2-F1/R2-F2 accepted). R3-F1: the idempotent-replay path returned a committed p.proposal without re-checking read_only — closed: replayed replies apply the same read_only gate (row unchanged, only the returned actionable surface suppressed). HTTP regression simulates the crash window (proposal committed via reasoning.turn, no draft), retries the same session/message/key under admin-only authority → zero drafts/missions/proposals, then proves authorized MC replay still recovers (proposal returned, idempotent draft mint). R3-F2: explicit request contract separates read-only query purpose from mission-creation purpose on the MC lane — the turns route now honors `body.read_only === true`, OR-ed with the credential-derived flag so a caller can only NARROW its own authority, never widen it. HTTP proofs: MC + read_only:true + proposal-emitting model → zero drafts; absent flag + actionable request → governed draft mints; declared read_only wins over actionable wording; mixed provider/cost wording neither grants nor revokes. Prior fixes retained: non-admin principals (operator AND telegram) are UNVERIFIED for scoped data (UNVERIFIED_IDENTITY, admin-only reads); admin credential bearer-only + boundary-scoped; strong admin secret fail-closed at boot; bounded valid-JSON envelopes; hook runs only after replay + stale-turn gates and mutates nothing.
